forum.title: Improvement: better tag searching when creating a post
forum.best_answer_content:
Thank you for your feedback ​@Aron Hoogeveen and adding more details ​@Andrew Neil.

Apologies for the late reply.

Adding the comment here as well from the [other linked post](https://community.st.com/feedback-forum-118/need-a-low-power-tag-167008) on tag search for transparency. As it was mentioned theret, this issue is currently under review and we keep you updated.

Kind Regards,

Zita
forum.content_text:
Searching for tags when creating new topics does not match tags midword. Example: when searching for “Designer” the tag “TouchGFXDesigner” does not pop up…

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a12a9522-8880-4ae3-b225-9b5c14540a13.png)

TouchGFXDesigner tag does not show when searching for “Designer”

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/fd845654-a6c4-4af9-952b-7b4cb67fbcd6.png)

“TouchGFXDesigner” does show when searching for “Touch”
